run_rationale: No candidate achieved n≥100 trades, making all backtest results unreliable for production wiring. Two UUP-based candidates (momentum_uup_v1, dollar_carry_uup_v1) show promising PF/WR/MDD metrics and cross-test independence, but with only 30 trades each and a simplified SMA-crossover proxy that does not faithfully represent the spec.entry text, a GO verdict would be premature. The three FXA-based candidates all failed T2 floor with negative Sharpe ratios. The run-level verdict is MIXED: there is a signal worth investigating further, but it is blocked on (1) longer historical data to achieve n≥100, and (2) the v3 faithful-signal translator to ensure the tested logic matches the intended strategy. Retry conditions: re-run with 10+ years of data and the faithful-signal parser; if n≥100 and PF≥1.5 persist, upgrade to GO.
